text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a k6 traffic-replay soak next Tue 09:00 PT. Need volunteers to run the job and capture profiles (pprof + perf) + GPU mem logs. Target: 1h steady at ~500 RPS, p95 < 800ms. Who can take lead?
todd: I can run it. Which cluster / env — staging or staging-mirror?
maya: staging-replay (mirror of prod). Please enable mirror-mode and set KV_PRELOAD=true so the cache is warm before steady-state. I'll post the command below.
todd: SG. Also want to collect system-level traces and heap profiles. Can we enable metrics-exporter + trace-bot sampling 100% for this run?
maya: Yes. Metrics exporter ON, trace-bot sampling=1 (full). Output artifacts to s3://redwood-loadtests/2026-03-replays/{run-id}. Make sure to tag with commit hash & model-variant.
chris: Quick ask — before the big run can we do a short baseline dry-run (10m at 50rps) to verify load generator and sanity-check configs? If we see regressions vs last baseline I want to pause.
todd: Will do the dry-run first and upload the baseline artifacts. If baseline looks good I'll proceed to the 1h soak.
sam: I can handle pprof live collection and gcore on the runtime nodes. Provide me the node list and PID or the container names. I’ll also capture nvidia-smi snapshots every 30s.
maya: Node list = staging-replay-pool-{a,b,c,d}; primary PID is the runtime container pid. Use `kubectl -n rh exec -c runtime <pod> --` for pprof.
maya: k6 command (copy/paste):
```
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 1h --rps 500 --out json=results.json 
  --summary-export=summary.json 
  --env REPLAY_MODE=mirror --env KV_PRELOAD=true 
  script_replay.js
```
todd: note: we'll set `--vus` to shape the arrival to 500rps, may use `stages` if needed. Also will enable `--system-tags` for trace correlation.
chris: Add regression checks: compare summary.json p95 to last-good (s3://redwood-loadtests/baselines/p95.json). If p95 increases by >15% abort and notify #eng-runtime.
maya: Good. Also enable request-level sampling for slow-path traces (>=500ms) so we don't overload tracing backend, except for trace-bot which is 100% for internal profiling.
todd: Assigning run to myself. ETA: Tue 09:00 PT, I'll kick off dry-run at 08:30 PT.
sam: I'll be on-call for profiling and will stream pprof links to the thread.
trace-bot: trace-bot: sampling mode set to 100% for run 1776004321, exporter target s3://redwood-loadtests/2026-03-replays/1776004321/traces
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: replay job queued (id: replay-1776004321), dry-run scheduled 2026-03-18T08:30:00-07:00, soak scheduled 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00
chris: Thanks — can someone paste the quick checklist I'll use to sign off?
maya: Checklist: 1) dry-run baseline uploaded, 2) KV preload verified, 3) metrics exporter streaming (cpu/gpu/mem), 4) pprof/gcore artifacts starting, 5) alerting hooks active (.pagerduty + #eng-runtime), 6) result files to s3.
todd: I'll follow checklist and ping here with artifact links.
sam: FYI will capture `perf record -F 99 -a -g` for 2m every 15m and upload perf.data to the same s3 path.
maya: Perfect. If anyone spots abnormal tail-latency during dry-run, abort and repro with smaller input. Otherwise proceed. :thumbsup:
todd: Got it — thanks. I'll post the links after dry-run. :eyes:
